title.text:
T11: the four clock variants month by month (walk-forward, 365 training days)
V0 = T01's S3 with the hour taken from FILE time; V1 = the hour in UTC; V2 = S3 + a 14-term New York basis; V3 = S3 + 96 UTC 15-minute slots. Left: the selection span, on which V3 won (mean skill gain over V0 +0.0199, V2 +0.0098, V1 +0.0004); the dashed line is the +0.01
minimum effect of the prospective test (+0.005 for the Spearman rows). Middle and right are report only: Binance months were seen by H83, 2017-18 is partly seen (T04-A) and has little training history.
